title: TaCZ Fallout Pack Audio Adjustment
description: Lowers the volume of sounds from the TaCZ Fallout weapons pack so that they don't make you deaf.
body:
Lowers the volume of sounds from the TaCZ Fallout weapons pack so that they don't make you deaf.
Most of the gunfire sounds and a few misc sounds in the Fallout pack were really too loud for me, so I made this resource pack.
